headline: OpenAI valued at $1.25 trillion, as rival Anthropic nears its IPO
summary: OpenAI's valuation soared to $1.25 trillion in its latest funding round. This makes it one of the world's most valuable companies. Rival Anthropic is reportedly nearing its IPO.

headline: China reportedly recruited AI exec to spy on Jensen Huang
summary: China's intelligence agency allegedly recruited an AI executive to spy on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. The goal was to gather intel on US AI chips and influence Nvidia's China access. The executive, Alice Huang, worked for Megaspeed.

headline: Starlink Mobile: SpaceX's Major Mobile Carrier Ambitions
summary: SpaceX plans to make Starlink Mobile a 'major' mobile carrier. Thousands of direct-to-cell satellites are already deployed. SpaceX aims to build out its 5G network to rival AT&T, Verizon, and T-Mobile.

headline: KPop Demon Hunters 4K Blu-ray now cheaper than Netflix Premium
summary: The 4K Blu-ray of KPop Demon Hunters is now on sale for $24.99. This makes it cheaper than a monthly Netflix Premium subscription. It's a wise purchase for fans watching the film in 4K.

headline: World of Warcraft Forever: First Level 60 Achieved in Three Days
summary: The first player reached level 60 in World of Warcraft Forever. This milestone was achieved just three days after launch. It marks the 'world first' for the new game iteration.

headline: Robert Pattinson Reportedly Screen-Tested for 007 Role
summary: Robert Pattinson reportedly screen-tested for the role of James Bond in Bond 26. Nicholas Hoult is also a contender for the iconic 007 role. Speculation continues about the next actor to play Bond.

headline: Avengers: Doomsday Ad Reveals Nightcrawler, Teases New Heroes
summary: An Avengers: Doomsday car commercial showed a first look at Alan Cumming's Nightcrawler. The commercial also sparked theories about unannounced hero cameos. Fans are dissecting the ad for new character reveals.

headline: Deal Found on Corsair DDR5 Desktop Memory Before Black Friday
summary: A deal on Corsair DDR5 desktop memory has been discovered. This opportunity comes ahead of the Black Friday sales event. The article emphasizes the relative 'deal-worthiness' of the offer.

headline: Meghan's Father, Thomas Markle, in Court Over Child Sex Abuse Material
summary: Thomas Markle, father of Meghan Markle, appeared in court in Florida. He faces charges related to child sex abuse material. His arrest followed an FBI search of storage units in Los Angeles.

headline: Trump Prepares for Battle with Stephen Miller as Chief of Staff
summary: President Trump promoted loyal partisan Stephen Miller to be his new chief of staff. This appointment is expected to lead to clashes with Congress. Miller is known as a firebrand.

headline: US Midterms Sparked AI Stock Selloff Due to Regulation Fears
summary: Fears of increased AI regulation following the US midterms triggered an AI stock selloff. Investor concerns about the industry have been growing for some time. The political climate contributed to market volatility in the AI sector.

headline: Brand's Barrister Refers Self to Regulator After Journalist Confrontation Report
summary: Russell Brand's barrister, Ian Winter, referred himself to a regulator. This action follows reports he confronted a journalist outside court. The journalist had been investigating the comedian.
